column3: MT 9:1. “Who will give” is rendered “O that I had.”
MT 9:2. “Their tongue, their bow of falsehood” is rendered “their tongue like their bow; Lies.”
MT 9:7. “Arrow beaten” follows the reading tradition (“sharpened”); NASB has “deadly arrow.”
MT 9:24. “Circumcised in a foreskin” is rendered “circumcised and yet uncircumcised.”
MT 9:25. “Cut off at the corner” is rendered “clip the hair on their temples.”
